name: mnemonic_temporal_shard_lock
label: Mnemonic Temporal Shard-Lock
godotFeature: Godot's Input Event Queue, Timer nodes, and ShaderMaterial for global post-processing effects.
poeticVision: The player feels the suffocating pressure of an internal clock, where every micro-hesitation isn't just a delay, but an active dissolution of Lyra's reality. The world around her doesn't just wait; it actively crumbles, tears, and blurs into fragmented unreality if the player fails to commit to an action with desperate urgency. This forces a primal, instinctual rhythm of constant decision-making, where pure reaction is the only shield against the mind's own entropy and the Silence's creeping grasp.

parameters.name: action_timer_duration
parameters.description: The maximum time (in seconds) the player can go without performing any critical action before indecision is triggered. Adjusts dynamically in editor.

parameters.name: indecision_memory_loss
parameters.description: The amount of memory integrity (0.0 to 1.0) Lyra loses each time indecision is triggered.

parameters.name: shader_intensity_factor
parameters.description: How much the visual distortion shader's intensity increases each time indecision is triggered.

parameters.name: shader_decay_speed
parameters.description: The speed at which the visual distortion shader's intensity fades back to zero when no indecision is occurring (units per second).

parameters.name: shader_node_path
parameters.description: The NodePath to the CanvasItem (e.g., ColorRect) that has the ShaderMaterial applied for the visual distortion effect.

parameters.name: critical_actions
parameters.description: An array of input action names (defined in Project Settings -> Input Map) that the player must regularly perform to avoid triggering indecision.

verdict: A relentless internal clock, this invention perfectly embodies the terror of fading identity, forcing desperate action against the encroaching void.
impact: This mechanic will immerse the player in Lyra's desperate struggle against forgetting, transforming every moment of hesitation into a tangible loss of self. It forces a relentless, instinctual gameplay rhythm, where the internal clock is as dangerous as any external hunter. Players will constantly feel the suffocating pressure of their own mind dissolving, making every action a fight for survival and identity, creating a uniquely stressful and deeply thematic experience.
